narrative.intro: Orano Federal Services has $900M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Orano Federal Services won 3 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $300M. Obligations are up 179824.9% year over year. Historical annual obligations show uneven activity: FY21 was $251K, FY22 was $1.5M, FY23 was $655K, and FY25 was $500K, before the large FY26 total. Industry concentration is narrow: Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing accounts for $900M of obligations. Current-year totals are partial, covering fiscal year to date. The FY26 totals are concentrated in a very small number of awards, which affects average award metrics. This snapshot identifies where federal spend landed this fiscal year and how that compares in absolute terms to prior fiscal years.
